page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; no marginal notes. Running head at top above the text, page number at top right. Text runs from top to bottom of the column.

main_text.l: partim ex aliis nostrorum libris pervi-
omni cibo, unde Græcis ἀ νῆ & ἰᾶϊεω
dicitur, ipsi verò dicunt jejunare esse
sua natura, sed ex delectu ciborum.

page.notes: Greek words in item 1 are rendered approximately (ἀ νῆ, ἰᾶϊεω) and should be checked against the scan; the faint rendering of the Greek for "fasting" is uncertain. Lower part of the page has show-through from the reverse side, not transcribed. Pieces of text at the page edges are partly cut off.
